手術中體內紗布即時辨識

Real-Time Detection of Gauze Inside the Patient During Surgery

在術中影像中定位患者體內術野可見的紗布，提供影格標記供醫護人員覆核。

討論類似專案 技術圖解

產業問題與工程挑戰

紗布置於患者體內術野時，可見範圍會隨取像角度與遮擋變動。畫面上的位置與時間標記能協助醫護回看特定影格。

工程限制

紗布摺疊、變形或部分被組織與器械遮擋時，影像中的外觀可能改變。術野反光與畫面模糊也須納入測試。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

已有 YOLOv6 與 YOLOv7 的紗布單類別設定及訓練入口。針對體內術野的串流方案，規劃分段量測取像、推論及疊圖時間。

成果

已備妥單類別訓練資料切分設定與兩組候選模型的訓練入口。

  • 紗布單類別偵測訓練設定
  • 影像疊圖與人工覆核流程規劃
  • 工況與端到端延遲驗證計畫

驗證與證據

共同發表的研究用手術影片和人工標註驗證辨識與時間線。工程端的串流部署另需以經授權的獨立影像評估漏檢、誤報及端到端延遲。

公開證據分類 · 研發中

  • 紗布盤點流程背景 · WHO 手術安全查核表

Selected Work

Real-Time Detection of Gauze Inside the Patient During Surgery

Anonymized Engineering Case · Engineering Development

Locate gauze visible inside the patient during surgery and provide frame-level markers for clinical review.

Open full English page 繁體中文 Plan a project Technical diagram

Industry problem and engineering challenge

The view of gauze placed inside the patient can change with camera angle and occlusion. Position markers and timestamps help staff revisit a particular frame.

Engineering constraints

Folding, deformation and partial occlusion by tissue or instruments can change how gauze appears. Glare and blur in the operative field also need separate testing.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

Single-class gauze configurations and training entry points exist for YOLOv6 and YOLOv7. The planned streaming evaluation of the internal operative field times capture, inference and the overlay separately.

Outcome

The existing work includes dataset split definitions and entry points for training both detector candidates.

  • Single-class gauze detection training configuration
  • Planned video overlay and human review workflow
  • Test plan for operating conditions and end-to-end latency

Validation and evidence

The co-authored studies evaluated detection and timelines against human annotations in surgical video. Streaming deployment requires separate validation of misses, false detections and end-to-end latency using authorized held-out clips.

Public evidence classification · In development

  • Counting workflow context · WHO Surgical Safety Checklist
